title: NeoPhylo exercise file
description: Lesson/exercise file format, schema v2 (v1.1 design spec section 3.6). This schema mirrors the validation in crates/neophylo-core/src/exercise.rs: unknown properties are ignored, `locked` and `prompts` are optional, and sim.kappa is required only when sim.model is "K80". `summary` is required only here — the engine ignores it — because repository lessons power the app's Lessons menu. Only schema_version 2 validates here — the engine still accepts v1 files (migrated on load) so old links keep working, but repository exercise files must be v2. Numeric fields follow the engine's effective ranges (sim.length 10..=10000, sim.seed 0..=2^53-1, at_step 0..). Model/alphabet compatibility, embedded-FASTA character validity and reference label matching are semantic checks the engine performs; this schema only covers structure.

summary.description: One-line lesson description shown in the app's Lessons menu. A display field the engine ignores (unknown properties pass through loadExercise).

newick.description: Newick string for the reference tree; its leaf labels must equal the alignment's labels (checked by the engine).

locked.description: Dotted control paths fixed for the lesson, e.g. "sim.model".

bootstrap.description: v1.2 spec 7.1: the lesson's own bootstrap settings — the panel's initial replicates and seed. Absent means the app defaults (100 replicates, seed 1).

true_tree.description: Newick string; every non-root node must carry a branch length. Syntax is checked by the engine, not by this schema.

fasta.description: Aligned FASTA text embedded in the lesson; it must parse and its characters must be valid under the declared alphabet (checked by the engine).

at_step.description: 1-based number of the join being discussed. The prompt appears at stepper position at_step-1, where that join is still the pending join; one past the last join (at_step = steps+2 for NJ, steps+1 for UPGMA) shows on the completed tree. A predict_pair must never target NJ's final three-way join — there is no pair to predict.

at.description: v1.2 spec 7.1: a predict_branch prompt is anchored to the bootstrap panel with "at": "bootstrap" instead of at_step; it shows when the 'How sure are we?' panel first shows.

reveal.description: Optional explanation a predict_pair card shows only after the student picks (e.g. why the closest pair is not the answer); must not spoil the question.

reveal_pair.description: Optional pair of taxon labels: the answered prompt card shows a "Show a vs b" button opening the pair-detail panel, and the next step's explanation keeps a "Revisit" link. Both labels must be alignment taxon names — checked by the engine at load, not by this schema.
